verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a GitHub Marketplace app listing, "Connect your code without leaving Slack." It points to a Slack integration, but the listing does not say it delivers repository or pull request notifications, nor whether GitHub builds it. Nothing covers Discord or Microsoft Teams. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repo/PR notification delivery to Slack, Discord and Microsoft Teams integrations, notification configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
